sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 4 x 4 x 16.1 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Sanken COS-11D specification page read 2026-11-12: "16.1mm X 4.0mm (diameter), 1.8m(cable length)", 24 g, output connectors per variant (Hirose KMC4p, locking 3.5 mm mini plug, Lemo 3-pin, TA5F, TA4F), powering "+3 V to +10 V", current less than 0.5 mA, colours BE, BK, GY, WH. The page lists no pigtail, XLR or 48 V interface and does not call the supply phantom. Reassigned from the family `assembly` (deferred) to `revolve`: a lavalier capsule is a plain lathe. The single port is the Bêta proposal's (an XLR output on a 48 V interface, flagged requiresPhantom, with its long id): NOT supported by this page, which lists a +3 to +10 V bias and capsule-end connectors, so the ports are not documented and the device is beta-modelled only; the proposal flag and its connector are to be checked in the data-rule audit. The port stands on the capsule base. The profile is our estimate; black chosen from the four colours. Generic wrap artwork only.
